% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): plot keys set between plots in the
% axis body (behaviour AB1/AB2): domain, samples and the cycle list are read
% at each \addplot; every axis plot and mark size are read when the axis ends.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xmin=-1, xmax=5, ymin=-1, ymax=12, domain=-1:1, samples=3]
\addplot {x+2};
\pgfplotsset{domain=1:3, samples=5}
\addplot {x^2};
\pgfplotsset{cycle list={{teal,mark=square*},{violet,mark=triangle*}},
  every axis plot/.append style={line width=1.2pt}}
\addplot {12-2*x};
\pgfkeys{/pgfplots/domain=3:5}
\addplot+[mark size=3pt] {x};
\pgfplotsset{mark size=1.5pt}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
